profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I'm an Old School programmer, comfortable with both high-performance environments and constrained-resource environments. I prefer working at as low a level as possible in a software stack but also enjoy crawling up and down the full depth. Network and multi-threaded programming have been recurring themes in my career. C is my language of choice but C++ is a mostly acceptable alternative and Go is even more acceptable.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Jack of all Trades. Developed large-scale distributed infrastructure for custom scripting environment including but not limited to: parser, compiler, linker, optimizer, scheduler, virtual machine, I/O library, multi-threading library, compression library, and multiple different network protocol stacks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained an in-house communications library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Shipped several releases of the Narus Analyzer, a real-time appliance for monitoring and analyzing network traffic at all protocol levels. Designed, implemented, optimized and supported all aspects of this product, which involved a Linux application running on top of customized device drivers and kernel modules communicating via shared memory.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on High Availability infrastructure for the CRS-1 distributed router.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drove all aspects of SGI's optimized MPI message passing library for three years as its sole architect, then co-led a larger MPI team for another 18 months. Shipped four releases of this product, culminating in the ASCI Blue Mountain 48x128 supercluster.

Co-designed, co-implemented and shipped a high performance OS bypass API and wire protocol for HIPPI networks. Participated in firmware, device driver, kernel and user-space software development.

Acted as software advisor on a team which developed a custom ASIC to implement the above protocol in hardware via GSN.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Ported and optimized scientific applications on a wide variety of parallel systems.

Prepared scalar application benchmarks for use in competitive procurement.

Developed and supported utilities and libraries for Cray vector systems.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Designed, implemented and shipped two generations of the JMH Easy Titler video presentation package for the Amiga.

Ported educational software from the Commodore 64 to the Apple II.

patents.title: Exchanging messages between computer systems communicatively coupled in a computer system network
